Name: Evelyn is Benita
Author: aylen13tejas
Description:
[center][size=4][b]Description[/b][/size][/center]
[color=#D4D4D8]I transformed sweet granny Evelyn into my neighbor and friend, sweet granny Benita. She has no idea, I wouldn't even know how to explain. Idk why you would want to install her, but if you do, please be kind to her. [/color]

[color=#D4D4D8](Sí, tanto ella como yo hablamos español pero me justa jugar SDV en inglés así que hice el mod para funcionar en inglés, aunque algún día podría hacerlo funcional en español también).[/color]

[color=#D4D4D8][b]Pending: [/b][/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]-Turn George into her husband Leocadio (I don't know how to remove his wheelchair without breaking the dialogue and heart events that mention it... but Leocadio does not use one)[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]-Figure out a way for her to have a cow and sell cheese.[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]-Maybe give her her traditional hat and lliqlla and maybe even have her speak quechua sometimes.[/color]

[center][size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size][/center]
[color=#D4D4D8][size=3]Download, and extract Content Patcher into your Mods folder.[/size][/color]
[color=#D4D4D8][size=3]Download, and extract Benita into your Mods folder.[/size][/color]
[color=#D4D4D8][size=3]Enjoy![/size][/color]

[color=#D4D4D8][size=3]Pls lmk if there are any bugs or suggestions. Also, if you update or translate this mod, please lmk too and credit me accordingly.[/size][/color]

[center][size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size][/center]
It's just good ole' Benita. Sweet andean cattle raiser who has been so nice to me and helped me in my dissertation. Does anything Evelyn would be doing, except she's not Evelyn anymore...

Update 1.0.1: Gave her non-winter sprite her usual braids instead of Evelyn's original bun.
Update 1.0.2: Made her winter portrait match her winter sprite

[center][size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size][/center]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Content Patcher by pathoschild, as far as I'm concerned.[/color][/size]
